verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only that Plaid's Transactions product retrieves up to 24 months of transaction data with webhook updates. Nothing in the pack mentions enrichment: no cleaned merchant names, no categories, no logos. Retrieving raw transaction data is a related feature, not the enrichment capability this story asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, raw bank transactions come back enriched — cleaned merchant names, categories, and logos — documented as a capability of the platform, not left as an exercise for me
